profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
•	Accomplished software engineer specializing in object oriented approaches to network and platform development
•	Extensive background in full life-cycle software development process including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, debugging, and maintenance
•	More than fifteen years of successful, documented hardware, software, web, finance, database and network technology development demonstrated proficiency and innovation including Army program management, acquisition, and operational support
•	Senior lead program developer for Army Sustainment Command’s Significant Issue Tracking System (SIGTRAKS) approved for global Army implementation
•	Solid program management skills using Lean Six Sigma implementation to maximize levels of productivity working within a multi-faceted, dynamic and cohesive team environment
•	Planning and preparing technical design and specification documentation
•	Strong work ethic and desire to work with team members
•	Ability to manage assigned tasks for multiple concurrent projects
•	Oracle 10g OCP Certified
Azure Data warehouse implementation

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Virginia Beach, Virginia, United States · Remote
positions.description: Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise software components, SQL Server database objects, and ETL processes supporting financial-services applications and data workflows.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Design and develop using Object Oriented design principles and software design patterns to attain high reusability and maintainability
•Develop and Maintain architecture and frameworks
•Develop database stored procedures and SQL scripts/ETL
•Participate and drive continuous improvement within Agile/Scrum teams
•Build consensus among different teams working on software development projects

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed database-driven applications and process-automation tools supporting system integration, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop testing.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and supported healthcare billing applications, process-automation solutions, and interfaces with external partners.

positions.title: Senior System Developer
positions.description: Provided senior development, architecture oversight, and technical deliverable reviews for the Washington Healthplanfinder platform.
